prompts.name: toeic_cover_up1
prompts.prompt: Upscale image 1 (a low-resolution screenshot of a Korean Telegram chat in dark mode) into a crisp, high-resolution screenshot. Keep EVERY Korean character, number, time stamp, check mark, bubble shape, bubble color, position and the patterned dark background exactly identical. Do not change, add, remove, translate or re-word any text. Only remove blur and JPEG artifacts so the text edges are sharp. No logo, no watermark.
